<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def bar_top(fr,c0,c1):
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='W':
            b=n['boundary']; cs=[p[1] for p in b]; rs=[p[0] for p in b]
            if min(cs)>=c0 and max(cs)<=c1: return min(rs)
    return None
def stem_top(fr,c0,c1):
    tops=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='B':
            b=n['boundary']; cs=[p[1] for p in b]; rs=[p[0] for p in b]
            if min(cs)>=c0 and max(cs)<=c1: tops.append(min(rs))
    return min(tops) if tops else None

def bar_top(fr,c0,c1):
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='W':
            b=n['boundary']; cs=[p[1] for p in b]; rs=[p[0] for p in b]
            if min(cs)>=c0 and max(cs)<=c1: return min(rs)
    return None
def stem_top(fr,c0,c1):
    tops=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='B':
            b=n['boundary']; cs=[p[1] for p in b]; rs=[p[0] for p in b]
            if min(cs)>=c0 and max(cs)<=c1: tops.append(min(rs))
    return min(tops) if tops else None
